definitions.gloss: gate; the doors of a gate
definitions.explanation: The doors or leaves of a gate, the part that opens and closes. A written word, used of houses, schools and public buildings and in product names for gates.

examples.japanese: {門扉|もんぴ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{門扉|もんぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧。
examples.english: The gates are closed at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{門扉|もんぴ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{錆|さ}びて→錆びる：07412_sabiru⟧、⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The old gate is rusty and makes a loud noise every time it is opened.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧ (gate) + ⟦{扉|とびら}→扉：04494_tobira⟧ (door). Formal and written; in speech people say ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧ for the whole gate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {門扉|もんぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{閉|と}ざす: to shut the gates (also figurative: to close one's doors)
- {門扉|もんぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open the gates
- ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{門扉|もんぴ}: an iron gate
